# A shorter induction at the bench

We replaced half of compliance training with supervised tool return. People remembered where the damaged equipment goes because they carried an actual damaged drill. The legal briefing still matters, and we must not pretend a friendly demonstration replaces it. [[Volunteer handbook]] should separate a rule that needs stating from a skill that needs practice. Jo finally left at the scheduled closing time.
